title: Automate changelog & onboard orionx-lite-5b v1.0 (perf profiles + metadata)
author: Maya Chen
commits: Add orionx-lite-5b v1.0 metadata and perf profiles
Extend changelog-generator to consume model metadata and perf profile tags
Add automated changelog entry template for new model onboards
Add unit tests for perf profile parsing and validation
Docs: add model landing page for orionx-lite-5b
description: Context: We are onboarding orionx-lite-5b v1.0 into the model registry and improving the changelog-generation flow so new model onboards automatically produce a standardized release note entry. Motivation: reduce manual steps for model metadata + perf profile ingestion and ensure consistent release notes for QA and docs teams. What this PR does: 1) Adds canonical metadata.json for orionx-lite-5b v1.0 (authoritative model name, decoders, tokenizer, default quantization profiles, sample inputs). 2) Adds perf_profiles.yaml containing benchmarked throughput/latency on representative infra (a100-40gb, intel-ml, t4) and recommended quantization/kv-cache settings. 3) Extends tools/changelog-generator to detect new model folders with a metadata.json + perf_profiles.yaml and emit a pre-populated markdown entry using the new template. 4) Adds unit tests and integration CI job to validate perf profile schema and the changelog generation step. 5) Small docs page under docs/models/orionx-lite-5b.md with an overview and links to perf profiles. Migration/rollback: changelog-generator changes are backward compatible and gated behind a feature flag (ENABLE_AUTO_CHANGELOG). Files of interest: model-registry/orionx-lite-5b/v1.0/metadata.json, model-registry/orionx-lite-5b/v1.0/perf_profiles.yaml, tools/changelog-generator/main.go Checklist: - [x] metadata + perf profiles validated locally - [x] unit tests added for perf profile parsing - [x] changelog-generator emits expected markdown using template - [x] CI workflow updated to run changelog-generator step - [x] docs landing page added Notes: the perf numbers are sampled from the internal benchmark lab (ref ENG-4278) and are tagged with the runner id so they can be re-run automatically. This PR intentionally does not change existing public model entries and includes an opt-in env var to enable automatic changelog commits by the release bot.
review_conversation: Ethan Reed: Left a couple of nits on the perf_profiles schema - can you add an explicit 'runner_id' field and a 'commit_sha' reference so we can trace results back to runs?
Maya Chen: Thanks Ethan - added runner_id and commit_sha to perf_profiles.yaml and updated tests to assert presence. (see commit 2)

Ava Patel: The changelog template looks good; suggestion: include a short 'what changed for users' line summarizing performance/latency trade-offs. Could be auto-filled from perf profile 'notes' field.
Maya Chen: Added auto-filled summary extraction in changelog-generator; falls back to author-provided 'changelog_summary' in metadata.json if notes missing.
Diego Morales: CI flake on the integration/perf step initially - rerun passed. Approving after the CI green and tests added.
Ethan Reed: Approve after addressing the template minor nit. ✅
release_notes:
- Onboarded orionx-lite-5b v1.0: model metadata and performance profiles added.
- Added automation in tools/changelog-generator to create standardized release note entries for new model onboards (opt-in via ENABLE_AUTO_CHANGELOG).
- Perf profiles include runner_id and commit_sha for traceability.
- New docs: docs/models/orionx-lite-5b.md
summary_of_changes: Onboard orionx-lite-5b v1.0 with validated metadata and perf profiles; add automated changelog generation with templates and tests; update CI to validate new artifacts
notes_for_release_bot: ENABLE_AUTO_CHANGELOG=false by default in CI; release engineering can flip to true during cut to allow automatic release note commits. Changelog entries are written to /changelogs/drafts/ and must be reviewed by docs before publishing.
testing_notes: Local: run pytest tests/model_registry; run tools/changelog-generator with --dry-run; Integration: github action 'integration/perf' executes sample runner and verifies perf_profiles schema. All checks passed on rerun.
